collection.description: A sociable villager has missed several gatherings, and a friend worries.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A formerly sociable villager has missed several gatherings. Their friend worries, but the villager says they simply need time alone.

choices.label: Ask directly how things are going

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The friend brings a small meal and makes clear there is no obligation to visit.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: They repair fishing nets in comfortable silence and slowly resume conversation.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The villager admits feeling lonely despite avoiding crowds; together they plan one manageable visit.
